bootstrap2.description: 2D bootstrap percolation, threshold 2, on an L×L torus (Chalupa–Leath–Reich 1979).
bootstrap2.rule: site facilitated iff >= 2 of its 4 von Neumann neighbours (N,S,E,W) are active
bootstrap2.citation: Chalupa, Leath & Reich 1979; Holroyd 2003, p_c(L) ~ pi^2 / (18 ln L)

spiral.description: Spiral Model on an L×L torus (Toninelli, Biroli & Fisher 2006).
spiral.rule: site facilitated iff (NE both active OR SW both active) AND (NW both active OR SE both active); NE=(x+e1,x+e1+e2), SW=(x-e2,x-e1-e2), NW=(x-e1,x-e1+e2), SE=(x+e1,x+e1-e2) — verified against Biroli & Toninelli, arXiv:0709.0583, section 2
spiral.citation: Toninelli, Biroli & Fisher, Phys. Rev. Lett. 96, 035702 (2006); Biroli & Toninelli, arXiv:0709.0583 section 2; p_c = p_c^DP ~= 0.705 (directed site percolation)
spiral.densityConventionNote: p here is the initial ACTIVE (empty) site density: createSeedConfig draws each site active with probability p. arXiv:0709.0583 section 2 states its threshold p_c^DP ~= 0.705 on the OCCUPIED (blocked) site density; in this measurement's active-density units that is 1 - 0.705 = 0.295, so this grid's densities straddle the transition at p = 0.295.

east.description: 1D East model deterministic skeleton on a ring of L sites (negative control).
east.rule: site facilitated iff its left neighbour is active
east.citation: Sollich & Evans 1999 (the model's glassiness lives in its stochastic rates, not this closure)
